name: Traumacore
garments: not a fashion look — an image-collage aesthetic built from found photos, medical imagery and childhood ephemera
reacts_against: sanitized self-help content, instead presenting distress imagery directly and without a redemptive arc — the aesthetic has drawn real concern about glorifying self-harm, and ColorHub covers it only as a documented visual style, not an endorsement.

findings: mostly muted — about 50% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
